description: This source file provides a utility function to encrypt tenant IDs using AES-128-ECB encryption in Node.js, utilizing the crypto module. It defines the encryptTenantIdNode function which takes a tenant ID and a tenant salt and returns an encrypted, URL-encoded string.

methods.name: encryptTenantIdNode(tenantId, TENANT_SALT)
methods.description: Encrypts a tenant ID using a SHA-256 derived key and AES-128-ECB cipher, then encodes the result in base64 and URL encoding.
